get.description:
What we have on hand: full goods per product, empties per container type.

    Every item that ever had stock.

    The matching ledger lines.

post.description:
Correct one item's stock, e.g. for breakage. Admins only.

Returns:
    The ledger line.

Record a stock count; each item is set to what was counted. Admins only.

Returns:
    One ledger line per item whose stock differed from the count.

Record full containers delivered and empties returned in one visit.

Returns:
    The ledger movements and the deposit to charge or refund. A 409 with
    code ``override_required`` means the empties are a different type
    than the fulls; repeat with ``override_reason`` to accept them.

Deliveries waiting for a driver, longest-waiting first.

Returns:
    The unclaimed open deliveries.

The deliveries you hold, in the order you claimed them.

Returns:
    Your open deliveries.

Deliveries waiting or held too long, for the POS to flag.

Returns:
    The late deliveries; thresholds are company settings.

Get one order.

Returns:
    The order.

patch.description:
Change an open order.

Returns:
    The updated order.

post.description:
Record what was handed over: final quantities, empties and payment.

Returns:
    The completed order with final totals. A 409 with code
    ``override_required`` means empties of another brand were returned;
    repeat with ``override_reason`` to accept them.

Cancel an open order.

Returns:
    The cancelled order.

Take a delivery from the pool. Drivers on shift only.

Returns:
    The order, now yours. A 409 means another driver got it first.

Put a delivery you hold back in the pool.

Returns:
    The order, back in the pool.

Take a delivery away from its driver, back into the pool. Staff only.

Returns:
    The order, back in the pool.

OrderCompletion.title: OrderCompletion
OrderCompletion.description:
What actually happened when the order was handed over.

Omit ``lines`` if everything was delivered as ordered, and ``returned``
if the expected empties came back. Otherwise list what really happened:
products left out of ``lines`` count as not delivered, and new products
are added at today's price.

OrderCreate.description:

container delivered" (a plain swap). Give it to say otherwise, e.g.
a new customer returns nothing.
